tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Section bands and table stripes. The off-white from ohiocityfarm.com.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info panels, the current week. teal text on it is 9.5:1, ink 12.2:1.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Dividers and decorative tint, from the site's nav. Never text: 1.5:1 on surface. teal text on it is 7.6:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The brand color, from the logo. Headings, links, the logo, focus ring, secondary button text and border. 11.6:1 on surface, 10.8:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: teal-muted
tokens.usage: Navigation and secondary labels at 14px and up. 5.0:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text. 14.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Help text, captions, timestamps. 6.4:1 on surface, 6.0:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and highlights, from the site's CSA band and Subscribe button. Text on gold is on-gold (teal, 5.5:1), never white (2.1:1).

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed. on-gold text 6.6:1.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and control borders. 3.2:1 on surface, the non-text minimum.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, confirmed, picked up. The site's dark green. 10.6:1 on surface. Pair with a word or icon: it is close in lightness to teal.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Declined card, errors, closed weeks. 6.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an alert (the notice on the sign-in screens). ink text on it is 13.0:1, danger 5.9:1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on public pages: Supper Club signup, the menu page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen titles in the portal and admin.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The farm's name in the header, set in capitals by the component until the logo files arrive.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. 16px minimum on phones.
styles.sample: Pick up Sunday or Monday at the farm store.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, values in summaries.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text, captions, table cells in admin.
styles.sample: Changes lock at the end of Monday.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav items, set in capitals by the component, echoing the site's spaced Montserrat.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: The label over a field, in sentence case.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The one-time code the member types, centred in its field.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and large panels on phones.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Height of a text field.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a primary or secondary button.

tokens.name: code-field
tokens.usage: Height of the one-time code field.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any control a finger presses: quiet buttons, the language switcher.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a card on a focused screen such as sign-in.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page's content.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards. The only resting shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.
